outcome: Maternal outcomes (obstetric morbidity, uterine rupture, placenta previa, peripartum hysterectomy)
Neonatal outcomes (low birth weight, very low birth weight, stillbirth)
cohort: Women who had two consecutive deliveries between 2016 and 2020.
finding: Women with a short interdelivery interval (≤24 months) had higher rates of uterine rupture, placenta previa, peripartum hysterectomy, low birth weight, very low birth weight, and stillbirth compared to those with a normal interval.
